description: For travellers in Japan. Give a place or sight in Japanese or English (e.g. Miyajima, 宮島, Naoshima ferry, Shirakawa-go bus, Churaumi, Aso crater, Kumamoto Station, Toyama Station tram, Ise Jingu, Naha Airport). Returns in one call: the next boat (time, minutes to go, operator, last boat today) and the next bus/tram/monorail (time, minutes, route, destination, stop number, live or timetable), the page URL and the JSON URL. Covers Hiroshima, Kumamoto, Okayama/Uno Port, Toyama/Shirakawa-go, Ise/Toba and Okinawa (26 places, 2026-09). Live positions only where operators publish them; boats are timetables. No key.

q.description: place or sight, Japanese or English; extra words like next/ferry/bus are fine
